Japanese and Indian firms designing a new offer together

Complementary capabilities may add up to something neither firm could offer alone.

The situation

A Japanese maker of industrial sensors believes its products could be combined with analytics software to help factories plan maintenance. It is looking for an Indian software company to complete the idea, and both firms would need to see value for customers and for themselves.

How SetuHashi could help

Search for complementary Indian firms, test the customer value of the proposed combination and the benefit to both firms, shape and test the offer with both partners, and support discussions on contributions, rights, revenue sharing and governance.

What the assignment could produce

Qualified candidates, an assessment of the proposed combination, a designed offer tested with customers and proposed development terms, agreed if the partners proceed.

The intended value

A joint offer shaped around customer needs, with each firm’s contribution and share of the value made clear.
